_comment: Every model the benchmark can run. Adding a model is one entry here and no code.
Prices are US dollars per million tokens and are copied from the provider's own
published pricing on the date in pricing_verified. Nothing here is estimated: a
price that could not be read from the provider is null, and the runner refuses to
run a model with a null input or output price unless it is given --allow-unpriced.
cached_input_per_mtok is null wherever the cached-read rate was not verified; the
cost estimate then bills cached tokens at the full input rate, which is an upper bound.
params: the run uses temperature 0 and max_tokens 320 for every model. A model entry
may override that only when the provider rejects the fixed value, and the override is
recorded in run.json and shown in the leaderboard notes.

modelId is the exact id sent to the provider. Prefer a dated snapshot id wherever the provider offers one; every run also records the id the provider reports serving, and the leaderboard shows it when it differs.

models.name: claude-opus-5
models.notes: Sampling parameters are rejected by this model, so temperature is omitted. Thinking is on by default and is turned off so the 320 token output budget is spent on the answer.

models.name: claude-sonnet-5
models.notes: Sampling parameters are rejected by this model, so temperature is omitted.

models.name: claude-haiku-4-5
models.notes: Accepts temperature, so it runs on the fixed parameters with no override.

models.name: deepseek-v4-flash
models.notes: DeepSeek prices differ between peak and off-peak hours. The peak rate is recorded here so every estimate is an upper bound; off-peak is half. Thinking is on by default, and api-docs.deepseek.com documents thinking as a request body object on POST /chat/completions with type enabled or disabled, so it is set to disabled here: with it enabled the model spent the whole output budget on reasoning and returned no text. DeepSeek publishes no dated snapshot ids; the endpoint lists only deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, and echoes the alias back, so the run date is the only version pin.

models.name: oracle
models.notes: Offline. Returns the gold object for every item, so a correct harness scores 100%.

models.name: null
models.notes: Offline. Returns null for every field, which is the abstain baseline: 100% on the abstain axis and 0% everywhere else.

models.name: qwen3.7-flash-2026-07-15
models.notes: DashScope US endpoint, the newest dated snapshot of the flash tier (qwen3.8-flash has no dated id yet), enable_thinking false. Run as the floor row. Prices from the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio pricing page (International, qwen3.7-flash, 0 to 32K context tier, which every call here falls in). Cached-input rate is not stated there, so cached tokens are billed at the full input rate, an upper bound.

models.name: qwen3.8-max-0902
models.notes: DashScope US endpoint, dated snapshot of the current top Qwen tier, enable_thinking false. Prices from the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio pricing page (International, qwen3.8-max, 0 to 1M context tier). Cached-input rate is not stated there, so cached tokens are billed at the full input rate, an upper bound.
